title: Arctic and Antarctic Museum
geometryBasis: Named museum node Q673942 lies inside native building way 61490767. The way provides a 21-vertex outline, four axial projections and a main entrance node on the Marata front.
sectionBasis: The public-domain Qualla original gives the green dome silhouette, overall mass and roof cap. The museum’s published history and written architectural descriptions support the preserved two-tier classical exterior, Doric columns and upper dome gallery. Heights and obscured facade details are visual and proportional estimates.
limitations: The dome profile, green finish and overall mass are visible in the exact 2008 photograph. The restoration scaffold obscures façade details. Doric porticoes, upper colonnades, closed rear bay, dome drum and smaller opening positions are interpreted from the historical descriptions and native outline.

The original source elevation grid is unchanged. Nearby DEM elevations include built-surface effects. The preview opening is limited to the native envelope. The independent unmasked original field records the difference between its surface and inferred floor levels.
The model represents the museum’s permanent exterior around February 2008. Separate chapels, temporary scaffolding and interior exhibits are outside scope.
